what: Minecraft 26.3 command-source authorization through command.authorization@1: the game-only base applies explicit grant/deny/unset semantics, and Fabric or NeoForge loader overlays supply their permission query.

overlays.name: fabric-26.3
overlays.why: Fabric Permissions API answers tri-state permission queries for command sources

overlays.name: neoforge-26.3
overlays.why: NeoForge PermissionAPI registers boolean nodes with the invocation's effective fallback in a dynamic context; context-free queries use each node's declared default, and the API queries players only
